title: Server
description: A base-URL declaration in an API description that names a network location (absolute or relative, optionally containing {variable} placeholders) to which operation paths are appended to form request URLs. It is declared in a 'servers' array at document, path or operation scope. Use ServerVariable instead when the element is a single {placeholder} inside a server URL, with its default and allowed values, rather than the URL entry itself. Use PathItem instead when the element is a path template such as /users/{id} appended after the base URL, not the scheme/host/base-path prefix. Use OpenAPIDocument instead when the element is the whole API description that contains the servers array, not one entry within it. Use ExternalDocumentation instead when the URL points to human-readable documentation rather than to a location where API requests are sent.

url.description: Base URL of the target host, given as an absolute URL or one relative to the document's location, and optionally containing {name} placeholders defined in 'variables'. Always set it; operation paths are appended to it.

description.description: Optional human-readable text, CommonMark allowed, identifying the host or environment the URL designates (e.g. 'Production', 'EU staging'). Set it when several servers are listed.

variables.description: Map of {placeholder} names (from the url template) to api.servervariable nodes defining allowed values and defaults.

x-dr-evidence: a 'servers:' list with 'url:' entries in an openapi.yaml/json file, or a @Server(url=...) / @OpenAPIDefinition(servers=...) annotation
a generated API client configured with a basePath or baseURL constant such as 'https://api.example.com/v1', often switched per environment
a framework OpenAPI setup call that sets server URLs, e.g. FastAPI(servers=[{'url': ...}]) or springdoc OpenAPI().servers(List.of(new Server().url(...)))
